style: Create ONE colorful PNG mobile app icon for Life RPG: SUBJECT. Premium playful soft 3D clay illustration, rounded chunky sculpted forms, clear simple silhouette, subtle warm upper-left highlights and soft object shading, cobalt blue, teal, coral, ivory and warm gold palette. Square centered composition, object fills about 80% of canvas with generous transparent margin. Transparent background, no background tile or circle, no scenery, no text, no lettering, no borders, no exterior cast shadow. Readable at 24–48px. Match a cohesive polished game UI icon family.
